about: Anthony J. Gill embarked on his legal journey with Keches Law Group in 2021, stepping into the role of attorney in the Personal Injury Department in 2022, following his admission to the Massachusetts Bar Association. His passion for aiding individuals in challenging circumstances was ignited early in life, as he played a pivotal role in nurturing his youngest sibling. His legal competence spans a diverse array of practice areas, including:

Hailing from Melrose, Massachusetts, Mr. Gill pursued his undergraduate studies at Stonehill College, earning a bachelor's degree in criminology and political science. During his college years, he was an integral part of the campus community, serving as a tight end on the football team and participating in the Best Buddies Program. His academic journey continued at Suffolk University Law School, where he honed his legal acumen.

While at law school, Mr. Gill gained invaluable experience as a student attorney in the Prosecutor Clinic, working with the Essex County District Attorney’s Office. This opportunity allowed him to refine his courtroom advocacy skills, and he was recognized for his exceptional legal brief writing during his first year. He graduated with Distinction in his Trial and Appellate Advocacy Concentration.

In the final two years of law school, Mr. Gill worked as a clerk for Keches Law Group and prior to that, he clerked for a renowned Boston civil litigation firm. He also boasts a “Very Good” rating on Avvo.
